title: NSFAS is late
text: Your allowance has not landed. The res group chat is one long sigh.

choices.label: Borrow R50 from a friend
choices.result: A friend sends it, with a voice note.

title: Load shedding at the library
text: Stage 4. The library lights die mid-paragraph and the generator coughs but will not start.

choices.label: Study by phone torch
choices.result: You get through half a chapter in a circle of light.

choices.label: Sit outside with everyone
choices.result: Someone has a speaker. Someone has a story.

title: Surprise test
text: The lecturer smiles in that specific way. "Notes closed, phones away."

choices.label: Write what you know
choices.result: Not pretty, but you filled the page.

choices.label: Peek at your neighbour
choices.result: They saw. The whole row went quiet.

title: Res Wi-Fi is down
text: The router blinks orange. Your assignment is due at midnight and the portal will not load.

choices.label: Buy data and push through
choices.result: R60 of data later, it is submitted. Breathe.

choices.label: Ask the lecturer for an extension
choices.result: A polite email. A short reply: "Fine. Monday."

title: A friend needs R50
text: Your friend from next door is short for taxi fare home this weekend. They look embarrassed asking.

choices.label: Send the R50
choices.result: "I owe you big." You believe them.

choices.label: Say you are broke too
choices.result: They nod. It is true for everyone, a bit.

title: Cafeteria special
text: Bunny chow special: half price until two. The queue is already round the corner.

choices.label: Join the queue
choices.result: Worth every minute. The gravy is a hug.

title: Bursary email
text: Subject line: "Application window closes Friday." It needs a motivation letter and two signatures.

choices.label: Write the letter tonight
choices.result: Submitted. A small first payment lands as a book allowance.

choices.label: Leave it for later
choices.result: Later becomes never. You try not to think about it.

title: Durban rain
text: The sky opens at once, the way it only does here. Everyone runs for the nearest roof.

choices.label: Wait it out with a stranger
choices.result: Ten minutes under the awning and you have a new friend.

choices.label: Run for it
choices.result: Soaked to the socks, but on time.

title: Derby Day
text: Sunday. Gold or Black. The whole campus is loud either way.

choices.label: Wear Black
choices.result: Black. Somebody lends you a scarf.
